newsitem.title: USA: Tuscarora sees Q3 EPS down 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tuscarora sees Q3 EPS down 20 pct.

text.p: Tuscarora Inc said Friday it expects to report earnings per share for the third fiscal quarter ending May 31 of about $0.20, a decrease of 20 percent compared with the same quarter last year.
The company said revenues for the quarter, while below management's expectations, should be about 15 percent above last year.
The earnings shortfall stems from the combined impact of two large customers adjusting inventory levels and reducing their packaging requirements, the company said.

The company also cited operating problems at two of its 29 manufacturing facilities in the United States and overhead costs associated with its recent acquisitions that have not yet produced the margin gains anticipated from the additional revenues provided by the acquired businesses.
The company said the operating problems at the two facilities have largely been rectified and the financial impact in the fourth quarter should be minimal.
The company said the sales slowdown that impacted the third quarter was limited to two customers and does not appear to be an indication of an overall slowdown in Tuscarora's business.
